summary.value: Repeals the Police Code prohibition on certain types of libraries lending or renting printed matter to anyone under 21 without a membership card obtained with a parent's or legal guardian's consent.

citations.quote: Ordinance amending the Police Code to repeal the prohibition on certain types of libraries lending or renting any book, magazine, pamphlet, or other printed matter to any person under the age of 21, unless the person has obtained a membership card with the consent of a parent or legal guardian.

title.value: Police Code - Lending Books to Individuals Under 21 Years Old
